1.w: A psalm. Sing to the Lord a new song, for he performs amazing deeds. His right hand and his mighty arm accomplish deliverance.

2.w: The Lord demonstrates his power to deliver; in the sight of the nations he reveals his justice.

3.w: He remains loyal and faithful to the family of Israel. All the ends of the earth see our God deliver us.

4.w: Shout out praises to the Lord , all the earth. Break out in a joyful shout and sing!

5.w: Sing to the Lord accompanied by a harp, accompanied by a harp and the sound of music.

6.w: With trumpets and the blaring of the ram’s horn, shout out praises before the king, the Lord .

7.w: Let the sea and everything in it shout, along with the world and those who live in it.

8.w: Let the rivers clap their hands! Let the mountains sing in unison

9.w: before the Lord . For he comes to judge the earth. He judges the world fairly, and the nations in a just manner.
